name: stanovina
description: Search live property listings for sale and rent in Montenegro and Serbia, read listing details and see market price levels.

interface.longDescription:
Find a flat, house, villa or plot in Montenegro: on the coast in Budva, Bečići, Petrovac, Tivat, Kotor, Bar, Herceg Novi and Ulcinj, in Podgorica, or in the mountains in Žabljak and Kolašin. Stanovina also lists property in Serbia, mainly in Belgrade, Novi Sad and Zlatibor.

Ask ChatGPT for what you need, to buy or to rent long-term, with your budget, size, number of rooms, a sea view or parking. ChatGPT searches the live listings on Stanovina and shows each match with its price, area, rooms, location and a link to the listing page. You can open one listing for the full description and photos, look up any town or district by name, and ask for the price level of a city: median price per square metre, rent and gross rental yield.

Agencies on Stanovina are checked by a person before they can publish: a moderator verifies each agency's documents, including its real estate broker licence. A listing published by an agency names the agency and its number in the national broker registry, and Stanovina publishes the licensing rules and registries of each country at stanovina.me/licence.

The data is read live when you ask. Prices are asking prices. The plugin does not give seller phone numbers or emails; to contact the seller, open the listing page on stanovina.me. The plugin is read-only, needs no account and changes nothing.
defaultPrompt: Find a 2-bedroom flat to rent in Podgorica under 700 euro
Apartments for sale in Budva with a sea view, cheapest first
What is the price per m² and rental yield in Tivat?

positive.description: Search rentals in a city with a budget
positive.prompt: Find a 2-bedroom flat to rent in Podgorica under 700 euro
positive.expected_behavior: Lists rentals in Podgorica with the monthly price, area, rooms, district and a link to each listing page.

positive.description: Search sales with a feature filter
positive.prompt: Show me apartments for sale in Budva with a sea view
positive.expected_behavior: Lists apartments for sale in Budva marked with a sea view, with price, area and a link to each listing.

positive.prompt: Find a villa for sale in Budva and tell me more about the first result
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the details of one villa: price, area, rooms, features, place, photos and the listing link. No phone number or email.

positive.prompt: Where is Bečići and what can I search there?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Bečići as a settlement in the municipality of Budva, Montenegro, and offers to search listings there.

positive.prompt: What is the price per m² of flats in Budva?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the median asking price per square metre, the rent level, the gross yield, the date of the data and a link to the market report.

negative.description: Seller contact data is not available
negative.prompt: Give me the phone number of the owner of a flat for rent in Podgorica
Book a viewing of this apartment for tomorrow at 10
What is the weather in Podgorica today?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: live listing search, listing details, place lookup and market price levels for Montenegro and Serbia.

sr-RS.subtitle: Nekretnine u Crnoj Gori
sr-RS.description:
Pronađite stan, kuću, vilu ili plac u Crnoj Gori: na primorju u Budvi, Bečićima, Petrovcu, Tivtu, Kotoru, Baru, Herceg Novom i Ulcinju, u Podgorici ili na sjeveru u Žabljaku i Kolašinu. Stanovina ima i nekretnine u Srbiji, najviše u Beogradu, Novom Sadu i na Zlatiboru.

Recite ChatGPT-u šta tražite, za kupovinu ili dugoročni najam, sa budžetom, kvadraturom, brojem soba, pogledom na more ili parkingom. ChatGPT pretražuje aktuelne oglase na Stanovini i za svaki prikazuje cijenu, kvadraturu, sobe, lokaciju i link na oglas. Možete otvoriti jedan oglas sa punim opisom i fotografijama, pronaći bilo koje mjesto ili naselje po imenu i pitati za nivo cijena u gradu: medijalnu cijenu po m², kiriju i bruto prinos.

Agencije na Stanovini prije objave provjerava čovjek: moderator provjerava dokumenta svake agencije, uključujući licencu posrednika u prometu nekretnina. Oglas koji je objavila agencija navodi agenciju i njen broj iz registra posrednika, a pravila licenciranja i registri po državama su na stanovina.me/licence.

Podaci se čitaju uživo. Cijene su tražene cijene. Plugin ne daje telefon ni email prodavca; prodavca kontaktirate na stranici oglasa na stanovina.me.

ru-RU.subtitle: Недвижимость в Черногории
ru-RU.description:
Найдите квартиру, дом, виллу или участок в Черногории: на побережье в Будве, Бечичи, Петроваце, Тивате, Которе, Баре, Херцег-Нови и Ульцине, в Подгорице или в горах в Жабляке и Колашине. На Stanovina есть и недвижимость в Сербии, в основном в Белграде, Нови-Саде и на Златиборе.

Скажите ChatGPT, что ищете: покупка или долгосрочная аренда, бюджет, площадь, число комнат, вид на море или парковка. ChatGPT ищет по актуальным объявлениям Stanovina и показывает для каждого цену, площадь, комнаты, место и ссылку на объявление. Можно открыть одно объявление с полным описанием и фото, найти любой посёлок или район по названию и спросить уровень цен в городе: медианную цену за м², аренду и валовую доходность.

Агентства на Stanovina до публикации проверяет человек: модератор проверяет документы каждого агентства, включая лицензию посредника по недвижимости. В объявлении агентства указаны агентство и его номер в реестре посредников, а правила лицензирования и реестры по странам собраны на stanovina.me/licence.

Данные читаются в момент запроса. Цены — запрашиваемые продавцом. Плагин не выдаёт телефоны и почту продавцов: связаться с продавцом можно на странице объявления на stanovina.me.
